lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd8Mg4Sb4 (reduced formula Nd2MgSb) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows each Mg and Sb center has eight Nd neighbors, while each Nd center has four Mg and four Sb neighbors, all at 3.4082 Å and adopting a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Nd-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner/face sharing between Mg- and Sb-centered polyhedra.
